summary: Stolen few Broken through truths hollowed into carvings. Loose atop time's askew whose clock? Chosen few Ticks lost in focus. Bogus Toks to Boogie on Souls Imploding us. Just hold on a Trusted mold #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Stolen few
Broken through
truths hollowed
into carvings.

Loose atop
time's askew whose
clock?

Chosen few

Ticks lost in
focus. Bogus
Toks to
Boogie on Souls
Imploding us.

Just hold on a
Trusted mold

#smallpoems
